# CodeGraph
English · 中文
> Turn a code flow into a **clickable diagram**, or a **long-form interactive explainer** — generate
d by your AI agent as a single offline HTML file.
CodeGraph is an Agent Skill for Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Cursor, Codex, and other Agent Skills
-compatible agents. You describe the flow; the agent reads the code, builds the artifact, and keeps
every element linked back to the source.
## Why CodeGraph
A normal diagram stops at the picture. CodeGraph keeps the connection to the code:
- **Click to source** — click a node, edge, sequence message, class, or relation to open the exact s

ource line in your editor, or in an in-page panel.
- **Review with context** — point the agent at a
PR, commit, or `base..head` range and added / modified / removed elements are highlighted in the gra

ph.
- **Diagrams or a course** — use a flowchart, sequence diagram, or UML class diagram for structu
re; or switch to **CodeWalkthrough** for a scrollable explainer page with sections, inline visuals,
source links, and an optional self-test.
Everything is generated as one self-contained HTML file. There is no server, CDN, or runtime `npm in
stall` on the viewer's machine, and the artifact works offline.
## Demo
**Review-mode flowchart.** Green is added, orange is modified, gray is unchanged. Clicking a node op
ens the referenced source line.
**Sequence diagram.** Same review colors, with actors, messages, and clickable source locations.
## Diagrams
Ask the agent to draw a flow or model classes; it produces a single `graph.html`:

ew mode for PRs, commits, and diffs;
- works in any browser, online or offline.

**Class diagrams** show classes, members, methods, and UML relations. Hover a
class for its stereoty

pe and responsibility; the rest of the graph dims so its
direct neighbors stay visible. Click a clas
s or a relation line to open source.

By default, keep one artifact focused on one question. When requested, a single
`graph.html` can com

bine one flowchart, one sequence diagram, and one class
diagram, each on its own tab. Duplicate diag
ram types are rejected.
## CodeWalkthrough: turn code into a course

CodeWalkthrough is not a summary of a file. It is a small course generated from
the codebase, built

not a summary of a file. It is a small course generated from
the codebase, built around three ideas:

- **Shallow to deep** — open with a one-paragraph mental model, then a
big-picture diagram, a runnin

g example, the mechanisms, the boundaries, and a
recap. Each section makes one point.
- **Visual fir

st** — data flow, state transitions, and call chains become inline
SVG/CSS/JS diagrams and animation

s. Code is an exhibit, not the main text.
- **Practice to verify** — an optional 3–5 question self-t

est, with multiple
choice or click-to-reveal answers that explain why and link back to source.

One running example is reused across the page, and every key claim links to a
source line. The outpu
t is a single `walkthrough.html` that works offline.

Use it for onboarding, explaining a module, or turning a design review into a
reusable lesson.

### Requirements

- **Node.js 18+** for the skill scripts. No runtime `npm install` is needed to
generate or view arti

facts.
- **Node.js 22.20+** for the `npx skills` CLI.
- A supported editor for click-to-source (VS C

ode, Cursor, JetBrains IDEs), or
choose the **Web** editor to open source in an in-page panel.
- **D
eepSeek Harness 0.2.x** for the DSH bundle.
## Use
Just talk to your agent in the repository you want to analyze:
> Use CodeGraph to draw the login flow as a sequence diagram.
> Use CodeGraph to draw the class model of the payment module.
> Combine a class diagram and a sequence diagram for this module.
> Review PR #123 with CodeGraph — highlight what changed.
> Use CodeGraph to explain the refund flow as an interactive webpage.
